rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank drives forward, there must be at least 80 pixels of free space ahead of it, and whenever it drives backward, there must be at least 80 pixels of free space behind it (the rule places no requirement when it doesn't drive at all).

deleted_starters.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.

explanation.headline: Proved: the one rule holds
explanation.summary: Verus proved rule S3 (never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px): the code only drives ahead when clearance_ahead is at least 80, only drives backward when clearance_behind is at least 80, and otherwise stays still. Neither battle, open arena or city map, showed any rule violations.
